title: Finding structure in disorder
description: Ramsey-theoretic mathematics research with Prof. William Gasarch at the University of Maryland.
body: My mathematics research includes Ramsey-theoretic work and collaboration with Prof. William Gasarch at the University of Maryland.
Ramsey theory asks when a sufficiently large system must contain an ordered substructure, however its parts are arranged. That question is behind the little two-color graph on this site.
availability: A project-specific abstract and public paper are not available here yet.

title: Machine learning at APL
description: Machine-learning research through the ASPIRE program at Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory.
body: Through the ASPIRE program, I worked within the Air & Missile Defense Sector at the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory, with a specialization in machine learning.
I presented research at the 2025 JHU APL Showcase and the 2026 Princeton IEEE ISEC.
availability: Technical details, a poster, and findings are not publicly available on this site.

title: A way into olympiad mathematics
description: An introduction that builds from early competition mathematics toward proof-based olympiad thinking.
body: I’m writing an introduction to the USA Mathematical Olympiad, designed to take students from AMC 8 and early competition mathematics toward USAMO-level thinking.
The planned book will be available for free. The goal is to make the path into difficult mathematics easier to find.
availability: The manuscript is in progress; there is no public download yet.
